Decaying_Rot_Wood_Maw.description: The Decaying Rot Wood Maw is a grotesque fungal cephalon, its toothed maw dripping with a corrosive black ichor that preys on the flesh and will of its victims, leaving only decay and despair in its wake.

Spore_Spewing_Puffball_Maw.description: The Spore Spewing Puffball Maw is a grotesque fungal appendage, pulsating with noxious spores that it can unleash in a choking cloud, while its razor-sharp bite is both a weapon and a means to spread its toxic spores further, enhancing the cephalon’s wisdom at the expense of its brute strength.

Cordyceps_Mandible_Maw.description: The Cordyceps Mandible Maw is a grotesque fungal growth that sprouts from the insectoid cephalon, transforming its jaw into a nightmarish maw filled with sharp, serrated teeth, each bite capable of inflicting a lingering bleed that weakens its victims over time.

Toxic_Amanita_Toothless_Maw.description: The Toxic Amanita Toothless Maw is a grotesque fungal cephalon with a gaping maw lined with toxic, vibrant spores that glow in sickly hues, capable of spewing a cloud of poisonous gas and emitting a haunting melody to lure unsuspecting prey closer.

Mycelial_Thread_Feeding_Maw.description: The Mycelial Thread Feeding Maw is a grotesque cephalon, a writhing mass of fungal tendrils that coalesce into a jagged maw capable of biting through flesh and bone with ease, its very presence granting its host a profound wisdom and resilience, as if the ancient, undying consciousness of the fungal realm itself whispers secrets of survival and regeneration.

Bioluminescent_Glow_Maw.description: The Bioluminescent Glow Maw is a pulsating, ethereal appendage that sprouts from the cephalon of a creature, its teeth glowing with a haunting light that both attracts and repels, while its fungal nature imbues it with a natural magic that reflects incoming spells and enhances the bearer's wisdom and perception.

Hardened_Shelf_Fungus_Beak.description: The Hardened Shelf Fungus Beak is a grotesque amalgamation of razor-sharp fungal mandibles encased in a chitinous armor, capable of delivering devastating bites while also providing its bearer with an additional layer of defensive fortitude and brute strength.

Slime_Mold_Engulfing_Maw.description: The Slime_Mold_Engulfing_Maw is a writhing, fungoid mass with a voracious, agile maw that can bite through the toughest armor, its sticky tendrils allowing it to traverse even the most treacherous terrain with ease, while its natural agility and dexterity make it a formidable opponent in close combat.

Crystalline_Underdark_Fungus_Maw.description: The Crystalline Underdark Fungus Maw is a grotesque cephalopod-like entity, with a massive, translucent crystal mandible that glows with an eerie, dark light, capable of ensnaring prey with its fungal tendrils and reflecting magical assaults back upon the caster.

Ghost_Fungus_Spectral_Maw.description: The Ghost Fungus Spectral Maw is an ethereal cephalon, its spectral form shimmering with an otherworldly glow, possessing a gaping maw filled with spectral teeth that can strike fear into the hearts of the living while its fungal essence grants it unparalleled stealth and wisdom beyond its spectral form.
